about_the_game:
Explore, loot and fight in an open world action game set in a post-apocalyptic future after a devastating meteor strike. Assemble your team and take the fight to the enemy or choose a stealthy approach to gain the upper hand. Expand your base to research new gear and get ready to survive the fall. Maximize your gameplay experience with the official book.

Content (selection):

  • Area Overview: Maps with all points of interest and resource locations
  • Choose your team: Overview of all survivors that can join you
  • Fighting the good fight: Get the most out of the diverse combat system combining real-time action, stealth and tactical pause
  • Know Your Enemy: All factions explained
  • Expanding your settlement: Tips to maximize the available facilities
  • Crafting guide: Improve your gear
  • Navigating the techtree: Choose your path to survival
  • Helping you to survive: Cooking recipes inspired by the game
  • and much much more

Please note that all additional content not available in game (the official book) can be found in the installation folder (e.g. "Steam\steamapps\common\Survive the Fall".
